parsed.post: Increased DEPTH to 10 and observed a val_bpb improvement from 0.817046 to 0.816220. The deeper model seems stable. Moving to test if reducing MATRIX_LR further can leverage the added depth for better convergence within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 10, slightly decrease MATRIX_LR and increase WEIGHT_DECAY to further stabilize the deeper model and minimize loss.
